top_signals.title: DeepSeek Plans AI Price Hike; Google Reshuffles AI Leadership | Bloomberg Brief 08/06/26
top_signals.summary: US equity futures waver as a tech-led rally loses momentum ahead of Friday's payrolls report. DeepSeek plans to implement a significant price increase across its AI services, while Google shakes up its AI leadership. Kelsey Berro of JPMorgan Asset Management discusses the upcoming jobs report and the implications for the Federal Reserve. (Source: Bloomberg)
